title: Verified by Construction: Machine-Checked Proofs for Hand-Written Transformer Circuits and Their Composition
read_level: full (Zenodo PDF, main text and appendices; Lean artifact zip not downloaded or built)
metadata_mismatch: corpus id is the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23976715; the Zenodo API resolves it to version record 23979055 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23979055). Title, author and date match. Corpus abstract was empty.
why_wsp: Gives Lean 4 machine-checked correctness proofs for agent-written transformer weight programs from a WSP study (Singh, 2026) and proves a grafting theorem for hand-written circuits appended to trained pre-LayerNorm hosts (refusal head, key gate, watermark), evaluated on OPT up to 6.7B.
domain: formal verification of hand-written/agent-written transformer weights; safety circuits (refusal, key-gated trigger, watermark) in OPT LLMs
editor: none in the paper for the circuits (hand-written by the author; AI coding assistants used for experiment code and Lean proofs); verified snapshots were written by an agent in Singh's WSP study
target: seven algorithmic weight-space-program snapshots "with up to about 1.3M parameters"; grafts into OPT-125m, 1.3B, 2.7B, 6.7B
interface: other (exact-rational export of float32 weights into Lean; hand-constructed circuit weights)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: Graft adds k residual coordinates; "the three circuit blocks hold fewer than 4 × 10^4 tensor entries (unused heads and units are not stored)" (Sec. 7)

headline_results.claim: Seven WSP snapshots proved correct on every input
headline_results.quote: we prove seven hand-written weight-space programs correct on every input of their task, with up to about 1.3M parameters, up to 26^9 ≈ 5.4×10^12 prompts
headline_results.where: Zenodo record description (HTML entities decoded); same claim in PDF abstract and Sec. 3

the proved refusal circuit ﬁres on 2480 of 2480 trigger positions in ﬂoat32 and ﬂoat16

headline_results.claim: Proof size not proportional to parameters
headline_results.quote: addition has 1,300,512 parameters and 1,699 proof lines, sort has 4,364 parameters and 990

baselines_and_controls: Sampled evaluation (200 examples by default in the source study; author's 20,000-sample check); float32 vs float64 vs float16/bfloat16/TF32/int8/int4 quantization and pruning transforms; host-only vs full fine-tuning; independent transcription of Lean definitions.
runs_and_variance: not applicable for proofs; empirical OPT evaluation on fixed windows (e.g. 80 windows for 6.7B) and 2480 trigger positions; single configurations, no seed variance reported
robustness_of_edits: Tested: "Quantization, pruning and ﬁne-tuning void the guarantees, and re-grafting restores the construction"; low-gain refusal circuit "full ﬁne-tuning erases its refusal within ten steps"; watermark survived float16, bfloat16, TF32, int8/int4 quantization, pruning up to 50% and 300 fine-tuning steps (Sec. 7).
verification: Lean 4 + Mathlib, kernel-checked; theorems depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; "No theorem uses sorry or native_decide" (Sec. 2). Floating-point behaviour measured, not proved (except parity model float theorems).
limitations_stated: Theorems are over real-valued weights; floating-point storage and execution measured not proved; exporter link between Lean constants and deployed parameters "rests on this exporter, not on a proof"; constructions do not resist a deliberate adversary; per-neuron weight-structure proofs did not scale for 1,000+ neuron layers.
code_or_data: Zenodo record 23979055 files: Huang_2026_Verified_by_Construction_artifact_v1.0.zip (Lean development, experiments, evidence) and LaTeX source
cites_or_builds_on: Takehi et al. 2026, Sparks of Weight-Space Programming (blog)
Singh 2026, Weight-Space Programming from scratch on simple tasks (blog)
notes_for_survey: Formal-verification counterpart to WSP: shows sampled accuracy can miss errors in agent-written weights (multiplication counterexample) and supplies kernel-checked proofs for seven snapshots from Singh's WSP study. The grafting theorem covers hand-written circuits added to any admissible pre-LN host; guarantees do not survive quantization, pruning or fine-tuning.
